parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return in each call. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录。取值范围：1~100。入参为空时，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The listener ID. You must specify the ID of an HTTPS listener or a QUIC listener
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the certificate. Valid values: Ca and Server
parameters.name: certificate_type
